ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central surface area (~80-85%) with sharp low-intensity (black) boundaries and distal markings (~15-20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white field dominant across both lobes. Continuous black pigmented band along the trailing edge. Dense, high-contrast black filigree and mottled clusters at both distal tips. Diffuse low-saturation yellowish-tan cluster visible on the mid-medial surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deeply recessed acute V-shaped notch; estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees at the peduncle intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous posterior boundary; irregular jagged peaks and valleys with varying amplitudes, particularly prominent on the medial-to-distal segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior curve tapering sharply upward and outward towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of circular white high-intensity spots (barnacle attachment scars) located on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe; similar clusters visible on the outer edge of the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of dark, fine-lined pigmentation disruptions on distal tips resembling rake marks; several faint vertical linear streaks in a tan-pigmented area on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity white geometric protrusions on the far-right distal tip, consistent with active barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-contrast 'ink-blot' or filigree-style pigmentation pattern concentrated at the distal extremities, exhibiting fine-line detail and high spatial complexity.
